attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **One listed line, two head names and two dates** — «Οσιος Κασσιανος (; - 1537)» and «Οσιος Λαυρεντιος (; - 1548)» — and two paragraphs, one for each; so it is an enumerated pair and therefore two folders, one each. **He is none of the corpus's five Cassians**: not of Axylou, of Bosoi, of Glyphia in Cyprus, the Greek, nor John Cassian; this is the disciple of Cornelius of Komel who kept his ascesis in the monastery of Komel. **Cornelius of Komel is named by the page and the corpus keeps no folder for him**, so he is named in the life without a link; `arsenius-of-komel` is a different man of the same monastery and is not brought in on the strength of the place. **No hymn, no birthplace, no parents, no relics.**
